Our bakery, Flour & Co., had a strong year in 2023. We brought in just under half a million dollars in revenue — roughly $498,000 — mostly from wholesale accounts (around $310K) and our retail storefront ($188K). Our ingredient and packaging costs ran about $189K for the year. We pay our two bakers and counter staff about $145K in total wages, rent is $36K annually, and we spent about $12K on marketing and social media. I take home $72K as the owner. We grew about 9% over 2022 when we did around $457K. We have 6 employees including myself.
